explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/184 (Erdős–Gallai): every n-vertex graph decomposes into O(n) edge-disjoint cycles and single edges, with the bound f(n) = O(n) uniform over graphs. A subgraph counts as a cycle if it is connected and 2-regular, otherwise as a single edge. The solved status rests on the cited OpenAI preprint, and a Lean proof is linked.
